detail: a heavy circular brass medallion stamped with an indelible iron-gall seal and ribbon of parchment, bearing the engraved seal of the Bureau of the Unwritten Atlas certifying that a territory, structure, or person has achieved canonical standing through years of repeatable observation

evidence.quote: The warrant rule: canon without warrants is cargo cult. Stage moves occur with ceremony and require an authored warrant.

facts.extent: 10 cm stamped brass disc with parchment counter-seal
facts.scale_ref: carried openly on a surveyor's lapel or pinned into an atlas folio margin
facts.material: cast yellow brass, cold-stamped iron-gall wax, linen-rag vellum ribbon
facts.state: embossed with indelible coordinates and dated audit marks

note: The Bureau's primary currency of provenance. When a developer or player manually edits an LLM-generated field note fragment, the Bureau detects the authorial refinement and issues a Canon Warrant, promoting the asset's standing.
